en: I heard you had the Demon Stone brought here from Lefkas...{wait}{clear}

Yes... as a precaution.{wait}{clear}No one is likely to steal the stone from here.{wait}{clear}Whether that stone is truly the legendary Demon Stone, we don't know.{wait}{clear}As you, Zig's apprentice, know very well.{wait}{clear}But... we cannot ignore the words of the prophets.{wait}{clear}
I am not needlessly worried about what happens in this world.{wait}{clear}I am simply giving careful thought to the safety of the lodges... of us mages.{wait}{clear}
＄＄＄＄＄＄, there's something I want to ask.{wait}{clear}
Yes, what is it?{wait}{clear}
About the Empire's movements... no, the reason for the world's turmoil. Is there anything you know?{wait}{clear}
No, nothing in particular...{wait}{clear}

I see... If you learn anything, will you tell me?{wait}{clear}I have to protect the Guild.{wait}{clear}I want to keep the Guild from being violated by the turmoil you speak of... the turmoil I've seen, too. Whatever it takes.{wait}{clear}
Yes, I understand. I'll help you as much as I can, Fein.{wait}{clear}
Thank you...{wait}{clear}
Damn it! If only I'd come back a little sooner...{wait}{clear}
We have to get away, quickly...{n}
Apologize{n}
We can't stay here long. The imperial army will come again.{wait}{clear}
I know... At least let me bury the Elder and my friends.{wait}{clear}I won't let them be defiled by those bastards...{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry...{wait}{clear}
If only I had... come sooner...{wait}{clear}
You don't need to apologize... If you hadn't been here, it would all have ended without my even knowing...{wait}{clear}
I took down the soldiers around here, but the imperial army will be back. Before then, I want to bury the Elder and my friends.{wait}{clear}
I don't want them defiled by those bastards...{wait}{clear}
＄＄＄＄＄＄... Can we talk?{wait}{clear}
So Serenis... is definitely in the Empire...{wait}{clear}

I'm the one responsible for driving her mad... I'll find her, and I...{wait}{clear}Please... if you learn where she is and what she's doing, tell me...{wait}{clear}I know this isn't something I should ask of you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}But I absolutely have to see her...{wait}{clear}
...?{wait}{clear}
What's wrong, Fein?{wait}{clear}
There's a presence in the darkness...{wait}{clear}
＄＄＄＄＄＄, got a minute?{wait}{clear}
There's somewhere I'd like to stop by. Do you mind?{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry, there may be an incident to deal with... Could we do it another time?{wait}{clear}
I see... That's fine. We'll go next time.{wait}{clear}
Yes, of course, that's fine.{wait}{clear}
Really? Thanks.{wait}{clear}
It won't take long.{wait}{clear}
This is the tower where my master and I lived.{wait}{clear}
It's been a long time since I came back...{wait}{clear}
Looks like Irene isn't here...{wait}{clear}
What sort of person is she?{wait}{clear}
She's Zig's granddaughter, and like a little sister to me.{wait}{clear}
She's lived here all along...{wait}{clear}
She doesn't seem to be in. She must have gone out on some errand.{wait}{clear}
I wanted to see her...{wait}{clear}
Can't be helped...{wait}{clear}
This brings back memories... Nothing's changed.{wait}{clear}
We came here to see Irene.{wait}{clear}
This brings back memories... It hasn't changed.{wait}{clear}
But Irene still seems to be bad at tidying up.{wait}{clear}
Going out and leaving it this messy...{wait}{clear}
Heh, come to think of it, Serenis used to scold her for that all the time...{wait}{clear}
There are a lot of memories here.{wait}{clear}
I learned all sorts of things under Zig.{wait}{clear}
And... the days I spent with Serenis and Irene...{wait}{clear}
It feels like it was so very long ago.{wait}{clear}
I didn't feel that way until I came back...{wait}{clear}
Here, I can feel the passage of time...{wait}{clear}
This place probably hasn't changed...{wait}{clear}
It's just... that I've changed...{wait}{clear}
Fein...?{wait}{clear}
How about it, ＄＄＄＄＄＄? Keep me company for once?{wait}{clear}
Yes, I'd like that.{n}
I'm sorry...{n}
Yes, I'd like that. You went to the trouble of inviting me, after all, Fein.{wait}{clear}
Is that place over there all right?{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry... I have to go now.{wait}{clear}
I see... That's too bad.{wait}{clear}
Well, you're a busy one, so it can't be helped.{wait}{clear}
Another time, then.{wait}{clear}
I wanted to take some time like this and talk with you.{wait}{clear}
We only ever talk standing around.{wait}{clear}
What's wrong? You look down.{wait}{clear}
Is something troubling you?{wait}{clear}
No, not really...{n}
Yes, a little...{n}
No, not really... I'm fine. There's nothing in particular.{wait}{clear}
I see... My imagination, then.{wait}{clear}
Then that's fine.{wait}{clear}
By the way, you didn't seem to know much about this world... How does it look from where you stand?{wait}{clear}Is it a wonderful world, worth saving?{wait}{clear}
Well...{n}
Yes, of course.{wait}{clear}Having touched this world, I feel even more strongly that I must fulfill my mission without fail.{wait}{clear}
Spoken like an angel. But do you really think so?{wait}{clear}To a pure angel like you, doesn't this world seem filthy?{wait}{clear}

No... I don't think this world is filthy.{wait}{clear}I... have never looked at the world that way...{wait}{clear}I think people here live as people do. Whether their path is wrong or right is for humans themselves to decide.{wait}{clear}I only want to keep this world from being used and destroyed by anything other than the people who live here.{wait}{clear}

I see... I don't think this world is a paradise either.{wait}{clear}Discrimination and poverty... no, the ugliness and foolishness of the people who create them...{wait}{clear}There are plenty of awful things. But this is a world I can't replace.{wait}{clear}I truly want to protect it...{wait}{clear}
Fein...{wait}{clear}
......{wait}{clear}I'm relieved to hear you feel that way.{wait}{clear}
Relieved?{wait}{clear}
Yeah.{wait}{clear}I thought you might be fed up with how ugly this world is.{wait}{clear}
That's... not true...{wait}{clear}I... intend to fight alongside you to the end. I have no intention of running away.{wait}{clear}

Sorry. That was rude of me. I apologize.{wait}{clear}Honestly, I didn't understand you. I thought maybe, as an angel, you were just passing the Heavens' orders on to us...{wait}{clear}I'm glad we could talk like this. Now I know how you think.{wait}{clear}Let's fight together... from here on, too.{wait}{clear}
No... I don't ask myself whether this world is worth saving...{wait}{clear}That isn't mine to judge.{wait}{clear}

I see... I don't know what you think of this world, but to me, it's a world I can't replace.{wait}{clear}I believe I have to protect it.{wait}{clear}＄＄＄＄＄＄, let's keep working together and fight side by side.{wait}{clear}
Yes, a little...{wait}{clear}
I see.{wait}{clear}
I'll listen, if I'm any use...{wait}{clear}
About the heroes...{n}
The cause of the world's turmoil...{n}
There's something about the heroes that's on my mind. Or rather... I'm worried whether I really understand them...{wait}{clear}
I see... So even you worry about whether you can understand people.{wait}{clear}But is that something you think about so your work goes smoothly? Or...{wait}{clear}
It's true that people may think I, an angel, only try to understand them for the sake of my mission...{wait}{clear}But that isn't all.{wait}{clear}
That isn't all?{wait}{clear}

No. When they're troubled, or when they're suffering, I want to do whatever I can.{wait}{clear}But if we can't trust each other, I don't think I can be any help at all...{wait}{clear}So...{wait}{clear}
I see... Maybe it's only natural to worry about that.{wait}{clear}
So that's how it is, after all?{wait}{clear}

Yeah. Understanding each other isn't something that happens overnight.{wait}{clear}It isn't easy even between humans. And you're an angel...{wait}{clear}However long you're with us, I think it can't be helped if we feel we don't know what you're thinking.{wait}{clear}
I suppose... that's true...{wait}{clear}
But I think your wish to understand us will surely get through...{wait}{clear}Talking like this, I feel you're someone I can trust...{wait}{clear}
Thank you, Fein.{wait}{clear}
Don't rush it. People have many sides. What you can see isn't always all there is.{wait}{clear}
Yes, you're right... I'll try not to lose heart, even if I make a few mistakes.{wait}{clear}
Ha ha ha... That's the spirit.{wait}{clear}
I'm concerned about the cause of the world's turmoil. I feel something terrible is lurking deep beneath what we can see now.{wait}{clear}But I can't tell what it is...{wait}{clear}

When I look at the world with you like this, all I notice is how foolish we humans are... The strong oppress the weak...{wait}{clear}But you're thinking of some other cause, beyond the turmoil we can see.{wait}{clear}

Yes. I think people do give in to all sorts of desires. But that is only a result they choose.{wait}{clear}But if those desires were brought about by something other than people... that would be truly terrible.{wait}{clear}

I see...{wait}{clear}Maybe I should look at what's happening now from a different angle, too...{wait}{clear}Thank you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. If I hadn't talked with you, I might have been caught up in nothing but the turmoil in front of me.{wait}{clear}
